raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The MoRI PD connector always creates the MoRI-IO RDMA backend. On a single node whose NICs are not cabled (or that has
none), prefill and decode therefore cannot use MoRI at all, although MoRI-IO also ships an XGMI backend that moves KV
with GPU peer copies over XGMI. Single-node PD (for example 1P1D, or 2P1D with length-based prefill pools) is useful on
such nodes to keep long prefills from interfering with decode.

## Modifications

`SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND` (default `rdma`, so nothing changes unless it is set) selects the IOEngine data plane of
`--disaggregation-transfer-backend mori`:

- `xgmi` creates `BackendType.XGMI` with `XgmiBackendConfig()`. The XGMI engine binds no port, so it returns before the
  RDMA port check. `XgmiBackendConfig` is imported only on this path, so the RDMA path needs nothing new from MoRI.
- AUX data is CPU-resident, so with `xgmi` it always goes over TCP (`SGLANG_MORI_SEND_AUX_RDMA` applies to `rdma` only).
- An unknown value fails before the engine is created.
- Both roles must see the same `HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES` list and pick their GPUs with `--base-gpu-id`, so a device id in a
  memory descriptor names the same GPU in both processes. Documented in `environ.py` and
  `docs/docs/references/environment_variables.mdx`.

The knob name matches `SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND` (`rdma` | `fabric`) in #44283, so whichever lands second only adds its
value to the same switch.

Example (one node, prefill on GPUs 0-1, decode on GPUs 2-3):

```bash
export SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND=xgmi HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --tp 2 --base-gpu-id 0 --port 30000 \
  --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-transfer-backend mori --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 8998
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --tp 2 --base-gpu-id 2 --port 30001 \
  --disaggregation-mode decode --disaggregation-transfer-backend mori
```

## Accuracy Tests

8x MI308X (gfx942), NICs down (no RDMA), MoRI 1.2.3.post1, DeepSeek-V4-Flash (FP8 per-channel checkpoint), TP2 per
server, DSpark on. 2P1D: prefill GPUs 0-1 and 2-3, decode GPUs 4-5, all with `HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5`.
The checkpoint needs gfx942 loader fixes that are not on main yet, so the end-to-end run used this same patch on a
v0.5.19-based tree; on main the change is covered by the unit tests below.

| | result |
|---|---|
| gsm8k (8-shot, 200 questions, greedy) | 0.91 / 0.925 (two router policies) |
| needle in a haystack, 8K-60K tokens | 12/12 |
| transfer / server errors | 0 |

Earlier 1P1D runs with the same change: gsm8k 1319 0.910 vs 0.907 aggregated, TTFT +1-2 % from the transfer.

Unit tests (`test/registered/amd/disaggregation/test_mori_backend_basic.py`, 8 passed on main; the 2 new ones fail
without this change): xgmi creates the XGMI backend although the engine binds no port; unknown values are rejected.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a kernel change. Standalone MoRI-IO XGMI writes reached 48 GB/s on this node.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -530,6 +530,11 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Maximum number of dispatched tokens per rank for the PPLX (--moe-a2a-backend pplx) NVSHMEM buffer allocation. Must be ≥ the worst-case per-rank forward tokens (the per-rank prefill chunk chunked_prefill_size / dp_size, or the decode CUDA-graph batch size); the server refuses to start otherwise. 128 + + SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND + Data plane of the MoRI PD connector. rdma uses the NICs; xgmi uses GPU peer copies, for prefill and decode on one node. With xgmi, both roles must see the same HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES and pick their GPUs with --base-gpu-id; AUX data goes over TCP. + rdma + SGLANG_MORI_QP_PER_TRANSFER Number of RDMA Queue Pairs (QPs) used per transfer operation

@@ -401,7 +401,9 @@ def __init__(
         # Set by teardown() to make worker threads exit (PoC: P<->D role switch).
         self._stopped = False
         self._worker_threads: List[threading.Thread] = []
-        self._send_aux_rdma = envs.SGLANG_MORI_SEND_AUX_RDMA.get()
+        self._send_aux_rdma = (
+            envs.SGLANG_MORI_SEND_AUX_RDMA.get() and self._mori_backend == "rdma"
+        )
         self._register_local_buffers()
         if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
             self._num_shards = max(1, envs.SGLANG_MORI_TRANSFER_SHARDS.get())
@@ -447,6 +449,11 @@ def __init__(
             self._start_heartbeat_checker_thread()
 
     def _init_engine(self) -> IOEngine:
+        self._mori_backend = envs.SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND.get()
+        if self._mori_backend not in ("rdma", "xgmi"):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND must be rdma or xgmi, got {self._mori_backend!r}"
+            )
         if self.kv_args.ib_device:
             os.environ["MORI_RDMA_DEVICES"] = self.kv_args.ib_device
 
@@ -465,6 +472,14 @@ def _init_engine(self) -> IOEngine:
             timeout_s=envs.SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ENGINE_INIT_TIMEOUT.get(),
             what=f"Mori IOEngine({engine_key!r}, host={self.local_ip!r})",
         )
+
+        if self._mori_backend == "xgmi":
+            from mori.io import XgmiBackendConfig
+
+            # XGMI binds no port, so the RDMA port check below does not apply.
+            engine.create_backend(BackendType.XGMI, XgmiBackendConfig())
+            return engine
+
         poll_mode = PollCqMode.POLLING
 
         qp_per_transfer = envs.SGLANG_MORI_QP_PER_TRANSFER.get()

@@ -901,6 +901,10 @@ class Envs:
     # MoRI transport and expert dispatch
     # ===================================================================
     SGLANG_DEEPEP_V2_FORCE_MAX_LEN = EnvBool(False)
+    # Data plane of the MoRI PD connector: "rdma" or "xgmi" (one node, no NICs).
+    # xgmi: both roles see the same HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES and pick GPUs with
+    # --base-gpu-id; AUX always goes over TCP.
+    SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND = EnvStr("rdma")
     # Send CPU-resident AUX data via RDMA instead of ZMQ TCP (default: TCP).
     SGLANG_MORI_SEND_AUX_RDMA = EnvBool(False)
     # Number of RDMA Queue Pairs (QPs) used per transfer operation. Higher

@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 
 from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mori import conn as mori_conn
 from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
 
 register_amd_ci(est_time=5, suite="stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd")
@@ -185,5 +186,33 @@ def test_elided_dst_entry_is_never_written(self):
         self.assertEqual(calls, [call("s5", "d5", "plan")])
 
 
+class TestMoriBackendSelection(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _init_engine(self, backend):
+        manager = object.__new__(mori_conn.MoriKVManager)
+        manager.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(ib_device=None)
+        manager.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+        manager.system_dp_rank = manager.attn_tp_rank = 0
+        engine = Mock()
+        engine.get_engine_desc.return_value = SimpleNamespace(port=0)
+        with (
+            patch.object(mori_conn, "IOEngine", return_value=engine),
+            patch.object(mori_conn, "get_local_ip_auto", return_value="127.0.0.1"),
+            envs.SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND.override(backend),
+        ):
+            manager._init_engine()
+        return engine
+
+    def test_xgmi_creates_the_xgmi_backend_without_a_port(self):
+        from mori.io import XgmiBackendConfig
+
+        (backend_type, config), _ = self._init_engine("xgmi").create_backend.call_args
+        self.assertEqual(backend_type, mori_conn.BackendType.XGMI)
+        self.assertIsInstance(config, XgmiBackendConfig)
+
+    def test_unknown_backend_is_rejected(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SGLANG_MORI_BACKEND"):
+            self._init_engine("tcp")
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
